column4: Bright electric blue light streaks whip across a luminous white space in a quick abstract sweep, with glowing white particles trailing behind, smooth fast motion, saturated high contrast color and a crisp bright finish.

Electric blue light trails curve through a bright white open space, crossing in a rhythmic dance, with sparkling white particles in their wake, smooth motion, saturated high contrast color and a clean bright background.

A bright wave of white and electric blue light rolls across the frame in a clean sweep, throwing glowing white particles ahead of it, smooth energetic motion, saturated blue color and strong contrast.
